To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the application of organic manure and In organic fertilizer on okra is a good practice for sustainable agriculture.
organic manures are better than inorganic sources in terms of yield of okra.

the application of organic manures in the form of vermicompost, farm yard manure and inorganic fertilizers in the form of RDF (N, P2O5 and K2O) in combination with recommended dose of FYM (5kg) recorded the maximum growth and yield of the crop.

the effect of organic and inorganic sources on growth and yield of Okra.
the effects of the application of organic manure and In organic fertilizer on the growth and development of okra.
the effects of organic manures on okra (Abel moschus esculen tus).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the organic manures are better than in organic fertilizers in terms of pod weight.
organic manures are superior to inorganic sources of fertilizers.
the application of organic manure in the form of vermicompost and farm yard manure (T5) is the best source of fertilizer for okra crop.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the application of organic manures in combination with in organic fertilizers is the best for the growth of okra.
the application of 25kg of vermicompost with FYM is the best organic source and the application of 23kg of RDF is the best In organic source for the cultivation of okra.
, application of organic manures in combination with inorganic sources of fertilizers is better than the application of only organic manures or only inorganic sources of fertilizer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of organic manures in combination with FYM is the best option for the farmers in terms of cost and productivity.

organic manures and inorganic manures are both important for plant growth and development and that the use of both organic and inorganic fertilizers can lead to higher yields and better quality produce.
